## What we collect

This site is a static website. It uses **no analytics, no advertising trackers, and no visitor profiling**. It does not collect participant, health, or personal data through the site.

## Hosting

Pages are served as static files (GitHub Pages). The hosting provider may process technical request data (such as IP addresses) for delivery and security; this is outside the site's control and covered by the provider's own policy.

## Personal data on profile pages

Individual profiles are published only with the person's recorded consent. Anyone listed may request correction or removal.
